methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This paper presents the analysis of the electricity consumption of the University of Unicomfacauca in Popayán-Colombia, which leads to the generation of proposals for savings, energy efficiency and generation of photovoltaic energy for self-consumption

stage1.ineligibility_reason: ISO 50001 energy-review / energy audit of a single university campus: it analyses and disaggregates electricity consumption and proposes efficiency (LED), substation consolidation and photovoltaic self-consumption measures. No EnPI/EnB measurement model is identified or characterised - no energy performance indicator, energy baseline model, normalisation/relevant variables, or fitted functional form.

paper_type.evidence_quote: For Unicomfacauca headquarters in Popayán, an analysis of the electrical energy consumption is carried out in a period between January 2015 and August 2019

stage1.notes: Bottom-up equipment inventory (power x hours x utilisation) compared to billing is the closest thing to a model but is not framed/characterised as an EnPI/EnB; no normalisation or indicator. Context is institutional buildings (university), out of scope for Level 3B regardless.
